name: run-depth-at-least
claim: the run governs only items of the first item's depth (sub-bullets are not governed: F2′)

mutation.from: (if x.item == some d then x.id :: runFrom d xs else runFrom d xs)
mutation.to: (if x.item.any (d ≤ ·) then x.id :: runFrom d xs else runFrom d xs)

name: continues-ignores-midline
claim: a mid-line continuation keeps the run going (F2)

mutation.from: def continues (d : Nat) (x : Unit) : Bool := x.item.any (d ≤ ·) || x.midLine
mutation.to: def continues (d : Nat) (x : Unit) : Bool := x.item.any (d ≤ ·)

name: lead-not-required
claim: a list reach needs a lead-in that ends with ":" (F2″, NotALeadIn)

name: odd-indent-item
claim: an odd indentation is not an item (spec 1.2)

mutation.from: | some _ => if (f - ls) % 2 == 0 then some ((f - ls) / 2) else none

name: para-counts-every-newline
claim: para counts blank lines only (L1, L1-p)

mutation.from: if c == nl then (arr, if blank then cnt + 1 else cnt, true)
mutation.to: if c == nl then (arr, cnt + 1, true)

name: merge-overrides-conflict
claim: a key both parts write is ScopeConflict, never an override (F1′, one owner per field)

mutation.from:
| some (k, _) => throw s!"ScopeConflict: {u}: {k}"
  | none => pure (Json.mkObj (ls ++ is))
mutation.to:
| some (_, _) => pure (Json.mkObj (ls ++ is))
  | none => pure (Json.mkObj (ls ++ is))

name: lookups-is-fields
claim: the joined object holds only members lookup finds (mergeParts_keys for every JSON value)

name: substOwn-skips-objects
claim: own is substituted at any depth, inside attitude nodes too (F-own)

mutation.from: | .obj kvs => .obj (kvs.map fun _ v => substOwn g n v)

name: ownSafe-ignores-exists
claim: own under an exists binder is not safe (F-own)
